purpose: Thirty independent body, hair, upper garment, lower garment, hat and accessory sprites for actual layered avatar composition
usage: Local artwork with unchanged alpha. SVG viewports position independent sprite parts onto a common 128x160 body; no runtime generation or external requests. Parts-v3.json records every source viewport and destination anchor. Master artwork is unchanged.
prompts:
Create a PRODUCTION MODULAR PAPER-DOLL PIXEL-ART PARTS ATLAS, not a sheet of complete dressed characters. The supplied image is ONLY a style reference for the compact friendly pixel avatar; do not copy its UI. New artwork: exactly 5 columns by 6 rows, 30 equal square cells, portrait canvas, transparent background, no labels or grid lines. Each row is a DIFFERENT LAYER TYPE as specified below. This is a real mix-and-match avatar kit: all parts share ONE identical straight-on, slightly-right-facing relaxed doll pose, same head/body proportions, same soft pixel outline, same light source. Parts must fit together when placed over the base doll. Keep the friendly simple dot eyes and tiny smile, rounded stepped-pixel head about 40% of full height, small body, short legs. True compact pixel art equivalent to ~64x80 pixels per full doll, upscale crisp square pixels, 2-3 shades per material, no realistic anatomy/facial detail, no painterly noise. Cohesive sage/coral/lilac/denim/cream/forest/ochre color family, subtle desaturated navy outline.

Important atlas rules: each cell contains JUST its listed isolated part, centered with generous transparent clearance. No parts touch neighboring cells. Fully transparent alpha-zero background. No shadows outside silhouettes, no checkerboard painted in. The cells in the first row are the ONLY full bodies; the other 25 cells are detached wearable pieces with transparent interiors where the body/face would show.

ROW 1 (five base dolls): five identical BALD base dolls with light, warm tan, medium brown, dark brown, and peach skin respectively. Same neutral cream short-sleeve undershirt and simple charcoal leggings, same cream shoes. Same dot-eye smiling face, hands loosely at sides, legs slightly apart, same geometry in all five. Bald heads, no hair, hats or accessories. No nudity.
ROW 2 (five HAIR/WIG layers ONLY): dark side-swept short hair; warm chestnut bob; charcoal high ponytail with simple full hair cap; soft ash rounded short cut; auburn soft curls. The face area MUST be transparent/open, no skin or facial features, no bodies, no clothing, no mannequin heads. Draw the hair cap/crown plus fringe and side locks, with a consistent opening sized for the base doll's face. These are wigs ready to overlay the bald base.
ROW 3 (five UPPER CLOTHING layers ONLY): sage hoodie; coral bomber with cream center; lavender knit sweater; oatmeal open cardigan with teal center; forest zip jacket. Complete torso and both long sleeves in the exact base doll arm pose, neck opening transparent, no heads, faces, hair, pants, hands or skin. Ends at the same waistband. Rounded shoulder silhouettes, subtle readable seams, no detailed folds.
ROW 4 (five LOWER CLOTHING layers ONLY): dark blue cuffed jeans; charcoal joggers; warm khaki trousers; soft navy shorts; charcoal pleated skirt over dark leggings. Same waistband and identical leg/hip pose compatible with all tops and the base doll shoes. Waist to ankle only; no torso, hands, head, shoes or skin.
ROW 5 (five HEADWEAR layers ONLY): ochre knit beanie; dusty-blue soft beret; muted forest baseball cap; cream bucket hat; lilac knit cap with tiny pointed ears. Hats only, open underside, no hair/head/face/body. All fit the same base doll head width.
ROW 6 (five ACCESSORY layers ONLY): small cream scarf with short ends; charcoal headphones to wear around the neck; simple round dark glasses (eye openings transparent); small brown cross-body satchel with diagonal strap; small muted-coral bow tie. Accessories only, no body, face, hair, mannequin or extra clothing.

All 30 objects should be clean separated pixel sprites. Keep head/garment opening shapes and attachment positions consistent across the set. Avoid finished dressed people outside row1, wigs with skin/faces, shirts containing hands, trousers with shoes, and hats containing heads. Original art; no branding, characters from existing games, numbers or text.

Edit ONLY the five detached wigs in the SECOND ROW of this modular pixel-art kit. Remove every skin-colored ear/skin patch from these wigs, leaving genuinely transparent holes there. Hair layers must contain ONLY hair pixels; keep their full existing hair silhouettes, fringe, ponytails and colors, with open transparent face areas. Keep ALL other 25 parts, the five base dolls, poses, garments, hats, accessories, lighting, colors, total canvas layout and exact positions completely unchanged. Do not add faces, heads, skin, new parts or text. Preserve the true transparent background. Also remove isolated stray red chromatic fringe pixels around the outer cutout edges without changing the artwork.
